system.description:
[Trigger: Setup]: You become [Flying].
Treat this effect as a Combat Status.
1/Scene.

This is a small backpack with a pair of wing decorations attached. It's a tool developed by a craftsman who was fascinated by bird wings, dedicating his life to its creation. It provides the wearer with the ability to fly for a short duration and grants high penetration power.

  • Pure White Feather [Core Material] (40G) 
  • Backpack (50G) + Lightweight Cape (40G) 
  • [Magic Catalyst 3] (25G) × 5 
  • Crafting Cost (105G)
